body: Build 0089. First extra-archive episode. A-Lyon (Saône riverbank, February 14, 1794): FAREWELL-A, 47ft — highest reading in the CARDINAL-3 network. Tyler in Lyon July 1793–February 1794 for the federalist argument, siege, Convention reprisals, mitraillade (December 1793). Never filed because Tyler believed the departure was survival, not love — a different category. The mechanism: FAREWELL-A regardless. Tyler: 'The mechanism may understand something about the Lyon departure that I have spent two hundred years refusing to understand.' 'Several' additional undisclosed sites confirmed. Retrograde is now an accounting of the partial record becoming less partial. RSI receipts: TYLER-073 (Footnote #77), Camera Op Entry 66, Jiangshi Memo #053, VC-001 Days 379–389, EMILY-SPRING-042.
title: TYLER S08E07 — Lyon. Build 0089. Network maximum.
